lines.en: We were children, I did not know
what love is, Milica,

lines.cyr: ти без мајка, јас без татко растевме.
lines.lat: ti bez majka, jas bez tatko rastevme.
lines.en: you without a mother, I without a father, we grew up.

lines.cyr: Година по година, мома стана убава
lines.lat: Godina po godina, moma stana ubava
lines.en: Year after year, the girl became beautiful

lines.cyr: а јас рака не ти побарав.
lines.lat: a jas raka ne ti pobarav.
lines.en: and I did not ask for your hand.
Do not wait for me, Milica,
once I put poison on my heart.
I thought you were not for me,
such was our luck,
to grow old one without the other.
If I had stopped time
and listened to my heart,

lines.cyr: дали ќе те имав, моја Милице?
lines.lat: dali ḱe te imav, moja Milice?
lines.en: would I have had you, my Milica?
You in a flowering garden
like a fairy,
I would ask for your white hand.
Do not wait for me, Milica,
once I put poison on my heart.
I thought you were not for me,
such was our luck,
to grow old one without the other.
